original_candidate_analysis.method: Original RGB inspection; read-only pixel row sampling; manual polygon trace; analytic GEOS polygon set/clearance calculations. No arbitrary fit and no runtime tests.

trace.definition: Includes horizontal pale stone edge lip, excludes vertical outer fascia/arches. Aperture includes inner vertical wall from y399 through y409 and blue sky to y445. Blue-sky-only contour is not a valid dry-floor mask.

uncertainty.note: Not exact segmentation. Vertices visually traced against original RGB, aided by RGB edge rows. +/-5 source px is a stated trace tolerance, not a statistical CI. This bound uses max axis scale and buffers all boundaries, intentionally conservative. Decorative rim exclusion is a separate semantic 8-14px change and is not hidden in this tolerance.

navigation.measurement_scope: Static polygon clearance only. No runtime/pathfinding, collision, wind, or combat tests were run. Widths count horizontal dry stone lip; separate inner-paving interpretation remains uncertain.
navigation.center_test_wind_note: geometry.gd lane_at() checks the actor center. Full-body wind-free bypass is a stricter geometric diagnostic, not the runtime lane trigger.

north_bridge_parallel_route.definition: Local north-bridge route excludes central/south branch by restricting centers to y<=420. Wind-free excludes centers inside actual lane rectangle, matching lane_at semantics.
north_bridge_parallel_route.interpretation: The current north bridge has a local center-wind-free parallel route. The measured footprint loses it even nominally on the runtime40-radius grid. A wind-free route still exists globally by detouring below the hole via the central branch. This is not a full gameplay reachability failure.

actual_navigation_grid_analysis.calculation_engine: GEOS C 3.13.1 via Python ctypes. Shapely was not installed and was not used. No Godot engine run.
